envelope.eyebrow: A separate constraint from calendar time
envelope.body: These caps bound additional learning work—not elapsed wall time or provider runtime. Undefined local caps still inherit ancestor limits.
envelope.notice: An extension of calendar days does not add minutes, episodes or remediation cycles. Work-cap increases require their own exact disclosed terms and approval.
